title: Model-specific runtime optimizations: Llama/Mistral/Qwen quirks + GQA/MQA tuning
author: Aisha Kaur
description: Motivation: reduce tail latency and improve throughput for popular open models (Llama, Mistral, Qwen) by applying targeted kernel selection, scheduler heuristics, and KV-cache adjustments; include GQA/MQA tuning to better utilize quantized kernels. What this PR does: 1) Kernel selector heuristics: add model-specific fallbacks for Qwen attention layout quirks and Llama assembly-optimized kernels; 2) Scheduler: introduce a lightweight per-model scheduling hint that biases continuous-batching decisions based on recent sequence-length histogram; 3) KV cache: fix memory growth on interleaved streaming for Mistral by truncating unused KV segments and adding a safe invalidate path for prefetched tokens; 4) Continuous batching: add a size/latency-aware batch splitter to keep SLOs while increasing token packing; 5) GQA/MQA tuning: add calibration profiles and auto-switching thresholds for GQA vs MQA kernels based on throughput/latency tradeoff. Commits summary: add kernel selector + tests; implement per-model scheduler hints; KV cache safe-invalidate + unit tests; continuous batching improvements + microbenchmarks; add tuning profiles for GQA/MQA + benchmark harness. Files changed (high-level): kernel_selector.rs (new heuristics), scheduler.rs (hint plumbing + unit tests), kv_cache.rs (safe-invalidate + memory accounting), continuous.rs (batch splitter and metrics), tuning_profiles.toml (profiles for gqa/mqa), docs + release notes. Performance results: microbenchmarks on a7-gpu cluster show median latency reduction of 12% for qwen-7b with fallback kernels, p95 reduced 18% for long-sequence Llama workloads, and overall token throughput improvement of 3-10% depending on workload mix; GQA->MQA auto-switching improved quantized throughput by up to 22% on 4-bit MQA paths in synthetic throughput tests. Compatibility & migration: default behavior unchanged unless customers opt into model-specific hints via model_config.enabled_model_hints; KV cache changes are backward-compatible and include an opt-out flag. QA & testing: unit tests added, integration perf runs in benchmark-lab, guarded rollout to 10% of traffic for 48h before full rollout. Checklist: [x] design doc linked (ENG-4821), [x] unit tests, [x] perf harness, [x] docs/release notes, [x] canary rollout plan. Related: ENG-4821, ENG-4870, SUP-9182.
